description_for_human: AI agents for every role in your company. Sales, Marketing, Accounting, HR, Legal, Strategy, Engineering, and more. Enter your website, get recommended agents, launch your AI workforce.
description_for_model: TheAutonomous provides AI agents specialized for business roles including Sales, Marketing, Accounting, Strategy, Product, Engineering, HR, Legal, Finance, Customer Success, and more. Each agent has role-specific skills, tools, and company context. 14 pre-built roles with 168 skills. Features: persistent memory, proactive task execution, inter-agent collaboration via @mentions, tool integrations (Apollo.io, Instantly.ai), credits-based pricing with 1000 free credits on signup. Target market: traditional small businesses getting into AI. Built by Chainflux.
